title: 6. Rumble-Rumble Fruit (Goro Goro no Mi)
facts: Fruit look from the user's oparchive screenshots (refs/batch3/DESIGNS.md)

plan.fruit: Drawn from the design you sent (refs/batch3).

lines.text: You take a bite#red of a weird spiky yellow#purple fruit.
lines.say: You take a bite of a weird spiky yellow fruit.

lines.text: Don't panic,#red that's just a Devil#purple Fruit.#purple
lines.say: Don't panic, that's just a Devil Fruit.

lines.text: Out of every fruit in the sea,#blue
lines.say: Out of every fruit in the sea,

lines.text: a Logia#orange that turns your whole body into lightning.#orange
lines.say: a Logia that turns your whole body into lightning.

lines.text: First, attacks#purple pass right through you, and you move at the speed of lightning.#pink
lines.say: First, attacks pass right through you, and you move at the speed of lightning.

lines.text: Then you shoot#red giant lightning#green bolts from your hands.
lines.say: Then you shoot giant lightning bolts from your hands.

lines.text: You can even make a thundercloud#orange that wipes out a whole island.#pink
lines.say: You can even make a thundercloud that wipes out a whole island.

lines.text: Your strongest#blue attack is Amaru: a thunder#gold god form with two hundred million volts.
lines.say: Your strongest attack is Amaru: a thunder god form with two hundred million volts.

lines.text: But it has one huge#purple weakness.#gold
lines.say: But it has one huge weakness.

lines.text: Enel called himself#purple a god on Skypiea,#green until Luffy punched him out.
lines.say: Enel called himself a god on Skypiea, until Luffy punched him out.

lines.text: Users of this fruit never need a phone#orange charger.#purple
lines.say: Users of this fruit never need a phone charger.

lines.text: Which fruit#pink do you want next?#gold Follow for more.
lines.say: Which fruit do you want next? Follow for more.
